title: Newmark Investor Solutions Launches Hotel Asset Management Business Led by Industry Veterans Dan Falvey and Steve Kakaty
summary: Newmark Group, Inc. announces the launch of Hotel Asset Management, a new service line within its Investor Solutions business providing independent asset and investment management services to hotel owners and investors.
body_markdown: Newmark Group, Inc. announces the launch of Hotel Asset Management, a new service line within its Investor Solutions business providing independent asset and investment management services to hotel owners and investors.
